centralQuestion: Does remote work increase or decrease employee productivity?

sources.summary: Argues remote work boosts employee output.

claims.statement: Remote work increases employee productivity by limiting office distractions during focused tasks.
claims.evidenceSummary: Remote work increases employee productivity by limiting office distractions during focused tasks. Employees working from home report completing deep work with fewer interruptions from meetings and hallway conversations.
